claims.rationale: Synthetic example: the target follows an observed recurring contract repricing and its cash collection; these are not real company facts.
claims.counterevidence: Synthetic example: the largest customer may not renew next year.
claims.falsifier: Recheck if renewal or cash collection fails to match the modeled uplift.

benchmark.description: Current annual sustainable earnings of 60, before the modeled recurring improvement.
benchmark.limitations: Illustrative inputs only; no empirical percentile dataset.

business.observation: Synthetic recurring contracts support annual revenue of 600.

cash_flow.observation: Synthetic collections and maintenance capex support cash conversion of 90%.

competition.observation: Synthetic renewal data indicate no loss of customer share after repricing.

maintenance_capex.explanation: Synthetic maintenance spending; evaluated separately from the NOPAT bridge, not added back to earnings.

cash_conversion.explanation: Synthetic cash conversion after maintenance spending; this ratio is not itself an earnings adjustment.
